searchLedger.hypothesis: An unrecognized dash option could be consumed as title text and allow a scaffold to proceed.

searchActions.result: The -?* option branch prints an error and exits 1 before the positional-argument branch.

searchLedger.rationale: The parser has an explicit refusal branch for unknown dash-prefixed options.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The inspected branch exits before any later scaffold handling.

searchLedger.invariant: A setup probe passes only when it receives a parsed route decision, and legacy serving is reported as failure.

searchActions.result: The probe requires exit status 0 and parses the last non-empty stdout line; the judge fails the legacy authority case.

searchLedger.rationale: The reviewed path does not treat a zero exit code alone as a successful route.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The setup judge verifies the parsed decision and explicitly rejects legacy serving.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A user-added sk-code surface after the native surface might evade the doctor ordering check.

searchActions.result: Check 5l scans modes after sk-code-opencode, exempts the two shipped examples, and soft-fails other surfaces with a repair instruction.

searchLedger.rationale: The inspected check covers the stated user-added-after-native case.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No false-negative was found for the check's declared ordering case; missing-native and broader router invariants were not adjudicated here.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A repository using the sk-git hooks might fail to enroll in Commit-Id stamping or validation on its first unstamped commits.

searchActions.result: The shared enrollment helper was read, but the full hook caller and repository-type matrix was not traced.

searchLedger.rationale: The named feature warrants a full hook flow review across repository types.
searchLedger.deferredReason: This iteration did not inspect all callers, installation paths, and first-commit cases.
